verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a memory layer, but the evidence describes ingestion only as conversation turns. `add` takes messages [mem0-docs-35, mem0-docs-43], and Mem0 extracts facts from the conversation [mem0-docs-26]. There is no evidence of ingesting documents, JSON, or business data, and community comments describe Mem0 as storing facts from conversations and say its structured/unstructured interface needs work.
